_meta._note: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.0.4 (March 2026, current as of 2026-05-10) refresh from https://artificialanalysis.ai/leaderboards/models top-30. AAII = weighted avg across 4 categories (each 25%): Agents (GDPval-AA + τ²-Bench Telecom), Coding (Terminal-Bench Hard + SciCode), General (AA-LCR + AA-Omniscience + IFBench), Scientific Reasoning (HLE + GPQA Diamond + CritPt). 0-100 scale. Existing aa_intelligence_index already had 18 scores; this adds NEW entries only (skips duplicates per (model, benchmark) pair). Updates benchmark to 'composite' category to group with ECI.
